fichas.title: Service rooms for lecture theatres
fichas.summary: Each lecture theatre should have a directly accessible side room that can serve as storage. Lecture theatres with experiments need a preparation area at the same level, close to the podium. Storage and staff rooms support building operation; wheelchair users must also have sufficient space in lecture theatres in line with standards.
